clauses.title: Limitation of liability
clauses.look_for: A cap on each party's total liability, and any exclusion of indirect losses.
risk_rubric: Cap of 12 months' Fees or more.
Cap of 6 to under 12 months' Fees.
Cap of 1 to under 6 months' Fees.
Cap under 1 month's Fees, or no cap on Carrier's liability.

clauses.title: Indemnity
clauses.look_for: Who defends and compensates whom for third-party claims.
risk_rubric: Mutual indemnity for third-party IP claims with standard carve-outs.
Mutual indemnity with broad carve-outs.
One-sided indemnity in Carrier's favour.
Customer indemnifies Carrier for Carrier's own acts.

clauses.title: Termination for convenience
clauses.look_for: Whether a party can end the agreement without cause, and on what notice.
risk_rubric: Either party may terminate on 30 to 90 days' notice.
Either party may terminate, on under 30 or over 90 days' notice.
Only Carrier may terminate for convenience.
No right to terminate for convenience.

clauses.title: Automatic renewal
clauses.look_for: Whether the term renews automatically and how far ahead non-renewal must be given.
risk_rubric: No automatic renewal, or opt-out notice of 30 days or less.
Opt-out notice of 31 to 60 days.
Opt-out notice of 61 to 120 days.
Opt-out notice over 120 days, or no way to opt out.

clauses.title: Governing law and jurisdiction
clauses.look_for: Which law governs the agreement and which courts hear disputes.
risk_rubric: A named law and courts in a US state.
A named law but no forum.
Foreign law or forum.
No governing law.

clauses.title: Security breach notification
clauses.look_for: A duty on Carrier to tell Customer, within a stated time, about unauthorised access to or loss of Customer Data.
risk_rubric: Notice within 48 hours.
Notice within 49 to 72 hours.
Notice 'without undue delay' or later than 72 hours.
No notice obligation.

clauses.title: Audit rights
clauses.look_for: Customer's right to audit or inspect how Carrier handles Customer Data.
risk_rubric: Customer may audit Carrier's data handling directly.
Customer may review independent audit reports of Carrier's data handling.
Only records for invoice disputes; no audit of data handling.
No audit or records rights.

clauses.title: Insurance
clauses.look_for: Insurance Carrier must hold, with cover types and amounts.
risk_rubric: Cover types and amounts stated in the agreement.
Amounts stated elsewhere and confirmed by certificate.
Cover required only by reference to another document.
No insurance requirement.

clauses.title: Subcontracting
clauses.look_for: Whether Carrier may use subcontractors and stays responsible for them.
risk_rubric: Customer's prior consent required; Carrier stays liable.
Prior notice with a right to object; Carrier stays liable.
No consent, notice after the fact; Carrier stays liable.
No consent and Carrier is not liable for subcontractors.

clauses.title: Data retention and deletion
clauses.look_for: How long Carrier keeps Customer Data and whether it is deleted at the end.
risk_rubric: Deletion within 30 days of the end.
Deletion within 31 to 90 days of the end.
Deletion only on Customer's request, or more than 90 days after the end.
No deletion obligation.
